name: m-techlabs-desktop
description: MTerm-CLI private workstation tools, currently powered by the managed Desktop Commander bridge.

interface.longDescription: MTerm-CLI connects to Dylan's self-hosted Desktop Commander bridge through Cloudflare owner sign-in. The standalone MTerm-CLI codebase and staging service remain separate until a tested migration. The server provides local file and directory operations, searches, documents, and terminal processes. Manage pause, read-only access, request limits, and connection health at M-TechLabs.com/admin/mcp. This private connection uses the free local Desktop Commander runtime, not pooled hosted accounts. The PC must be on and signed in. Read-only policy blocks writes and process launches until the owner explicitly changes it. Existing hosted Remote Desktop Commander accounts and AI subscriptions remain separate.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use MTerm-CLI to verify my managed workstation tools and help me safely work on my PC.
